message.content:
Viper has expressed a desire to increase their stamina during workouts. To achieve this, they plan to incorporate interval training into their cardio routine. Interval training involves alternating periods of high-intensity exercise with periods of lower intensity or rest. This method is beneficial for building endurance and can be tailored to an individual's comfort level by starting with shorter intervals and gradually increasing the intensity and duration as confidence and fitness improve. Viper shares their positive experience with interval training, noting that it not only bolsters stamina but also adds variety to their workouts.

In summary, Viper's strategy to enhance stamina revolves around the use of interval training, which they have already found to be effective. They suggest beginning with manageable intervals and progressively extending them while ensuring proper form to prevent injury and maintain a sustainable and enjoyable workout experience. Viper encourages others who may be seeking similar improvements to consider this approach as well.
